homepage.title: The Streets of Danzig
homepage.description: Explore the rich history and culture of Danzig through its streets, people, and stories.
homepage.districtsSubtitle: Mapping the socio-economic topography of the Free City. Explore the distinct identities of the historical quarters.
homepage.seoTextFallback1: The Streets of Danzig project is a digital attempt to reconcile the layered history of a city that has existed under multiple identities.
homepage.seoTextFallback2: Our archival goals focus on the preservation of toponymy—the names of places.

alldistricts.header: List of All Districts in Danzig
alldistricts.intro1: Danzig's architectural evolution is a testament to centuries of merchant ambition and maritime influence. From the medieval density of the Rechtstadt to the industrial expansion of the 19th-century suburbs, each district preserves a specific layer of European history.
alldistricts.intro2: Our visual directory offers a curated passage through these historical enclaves, mapped not just by geography but by the narratives of the families, artisans, and sailors who defined its streets.
